name: David Brog

lean.basis: By his own account a Democrat until law school (Harvard Law, 1991).

Chief of staff to Republican Sen. Arlen Specter; led Christians United for Israel and the Adelson-funded Maccabee Task Force; ran in the 2022 Republican primary for Nevada's 1st district, endorsed by Mike Pompeo, pledging to finish Trump's border wall.

current_role: Co-founder and president of the Edmund Burke Foundation (National Conservatism Conference)
summary: David Brog is an American conservative activist. A Harvard-trained lawyer, he was chief of staff to Sen. Arlen Specter and staff director of the Senate Judiciary Committee, then ran Christians United for Israel from 2006 to 2015 and the Adelson- and Saban-funded Maccabee Task Force against campus BDS. In 2019 he co-founded the Edmund Burke Foundation with Yoram Hazony and co-organizes the NatCon conferences. He is a cousin of former Israeli prime minister Ehud Barak.
